name: Hanon Systems
summary: Hanon Systems provides automotive thermal management solutions in Korea. The company offers heating, ventilation, and air conditioning technologies, such as omnifarious HVAC designs, high-efficiency blower scrolls, visible (VR) LED photocatalyst, co2 sensor, and fragrance system; compressors, including fixed swash plate, rotary suction, variable swash plate, and electric; and fluid transport products includes refrigerant lines, coolant lines, transmission oil cooler lines, accumulators, receiver driers, and internal heat exchangers FT.
